args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on the vacation itinerary for June 10th - June 20th, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki Beach and Kailua Beach)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Casual outfits (for various activities and occasions)
- Camera (to capture memories at all locations)
- Travel documents (flight tickets, hotel reservations, IDs)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Snorkeling equipment (or rent at Hanauma Bay on June 12)
- Comfortable walking shoes (for hiking and sightseeing)
- Light jacket (for evening activities)
- Beach towel
- Hat and sunglasses
- Waterproof phone case
- Day backpack for excursions
- Reusable water bottle
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent

Activity-Specific Items:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach towel, swimwear, sunscreen
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay): Snorkeling mask, fins (or rent there)
- June 13 (Diamond Head): Hiking boots, water, hat
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Comfortable walking shoes, camera
- June 15 (North Shore): Swimwear, sunscreen, beach gear
- June 16 (Luau): Casual resort wear, camera
- June 17 (Spa day): Spa attire, comfortable clothes
- June 18 (Kailua Beach): Kayaking gear, swimwear
- June 19 (Shopping): Comfortable shoes, shopping bags
- June 20 (Departure): Travel documents, souvenirs

Don't forget to check weather forecast before packing!
